notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for both dealing with Barrier Champions and clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Scathelocke is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. Barrier Champions are a little more difficult deal with at range in the final sandbox so, for a roll that can fill that role as well as help with dealing with Minor add groups, in the first trait perk column Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~19 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods, or Shoot to Loot lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves. In the second column, Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts and also proc weapon effects like Attrition Orbs' orb generation and Shoot to Loot's ammo and orb pickup. Aegis ranks the Veteran's Wisdom origin trait as S-Tier for PvE - it procs on a crit kill or 3 kills within 3s of each other to generate an 9m AoE kinetic shockwave which inflicts Exhaust on enemies. There's also the C-Tier Field Tested, which starts subtly but if you can stay alive to get hits and kills, you'll start to feel the boosts to Range, Stability, Handling and Reload Speed as you get to the higher stacks. If you're interested, Scathelocke is an alternate name for Will Scarlet, one of Robin Hood's legendary "Merry Men" in English folklore. It's a compound of the Old Norse/ Middle English word "scathe" (meaning to injure, harm, or obliterate) and "lock" (as in a lock of hair). Historically, this surname was often given as a nickname to an aggressive fighter or an incompetent barber. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
